# Feely Developments

> Residential custom homes and remodeling in Winter Park, Florida. "From Real Estate services, design, demo, all the way through move in, our construction team has been serving our neighbors since 2007." Their motto is Design-Build-Live. Ryan Feely, CEO, meets with clients about a custom home or a remodel. Licensed by the State of Florida as Feely Developments LLC: Certified Building Contractor CBC1268587 and Certified Residential Contractor CRC1330421, both current and active through August 31, 2028, on the registry of the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation. Address: 160 Whipple Avenue, Winter Park, Florida 32789. Phone (321) 663-1433; email FeelyDev@gmail.com. They get back to every request within five business days.

## Design-Build-Live

- [Design](https://feelydevelopments.com/#design): "Our services transform your dream from paper to a residence."
- [Build](https://feelydevelopments.com/#build): "Our goal is simply to serve our clients and honor their custom home through dedication, respect and hard work." One team from real estate to move-in: real estate services, design, demo, construction, move-in.
- [Live](https://feelydevelopments.com/#live): "Our passion is building a luxury home you love to live in."

## Available homes

- [Palmer Avenue, Winter Park, under construction](https://feelydevelopments.com/#homes): a Modern French Country Villa to be built on a 0.36-acre lot along tree-lined Palmer Avenue, with 7,426 sq ft under roof, offered at $5,800,000. A double-gated private entry and a green perimeter wall for security and privacy; designed by a team of architects and interior designers for a modern, yet gracious interior. Plans and price may change.
- [Whipple Avenue, Winter Park, sold](https://feelydevelopments.com/#homes): a Modern French Revival residence steps from Park Avenue and Winter Park's restaurants, shopping, golf and museums. All the living areas and bedrooms are upstairs, with a metal-and-glass elevator, stairs and floor-to-ceiling windows; downstairs is made for entertaining, with a private office, an apartment, a bar, a living room, casual dining and an outdoor kitchen.
